title.rendered: How Much Is a Abu Dhabi Visa? A Complete Guide to Fees & Types

content.rendered:
Abu Dhabi, with its iconic skyline, extravagant shopping goals, and wealthy social heritage, has ended up being a premier goal for travelers around the world. For Pakistani citizens eager to investigate this dynamic city, understanding the visa application preparation and related costs is significant. This directly gives detailed bits of knowledge about the different Abu Dhabi visa choices, their expenses, and how Waytransit Travels & Tourism can help in making your travel consistent. 

Understanding Abu Dhabi Visa Types and Their Costs

The United Arab Emirates (UAE) offers a few visa categories custom-made for diverse travel purposes. For Pakistani travelers, the foremost common visa types include:

  • Tourist Visa

Duration Options:

  • 14-Day Visa: Ideal for short vacations or business trips.
  • 30-Day Visa: Best for extended holidays or visiting family and friends.
  • 60-Day Visa: For those planning longer stays, for leisure, or exploring business opportunities.

          Estimated Costs:

  • 14-Day Visa: Approximately AED 350
  • 30-Day Visa: Around AED 500
  • 30-Day Visa: Around AED 500

These are not fixed costs they are approximate and can change. For better and authentic knowledge you can always contact Waytransit Travels & Tourism for information.

  • Transit Visa

These are for people who want a short trip during layovers.

Duration Options:

  • 48-Hour Visa: Perfect for short stopovers.
  • 96-Hour Visa: Allows for a more extended exploration of the city’s highlights.

Estimated Costs:

  •  48-Hour Visa: Approximately AED 50.
  • 96-Hour Visa: Around AED 150.
  • Multiple Entry Visa

Best for people who want to visit family frequently and have business.

Duration Options:

  • 30-Day Multiple Entry Visa: Allows multiple entries within 30 days.
  • 60-Day Multiple Entry Visa: Permits multiple entries within 60 days.

Estimated Costs:

  • 30-Day Multiple Entry Visa: Approximately AED 1,500.
  • 60-Day Multiple Entry Visa: Around AED 2,500.

Essential Requirements for Pakistani Applicants

To make sure your visa process is smooth here are some requirements that need to be fulfilled.

  • Valid Passport: Your passport should have a validity of a minimum of 6 months from the travel date.
  • Passport-Sized Photograph: An updated and recent photo of yours with a white background.
  • Completed Visa Application Form: Correctly filled and signed form.
  • Proof of Accommodation: Proof of hotel booking or a signed authentic letter from a host in UAE.
  • Flight Itinerary: Confirmed return flight or next flight.
  • Financial Proof: Bank statements and proof if someone is sponsoring.

Processing Time and Application Procedure

Processing Time:

  • Standard Processing: Typically takes 3 to 4 working days.
  • Express Processing: Available at an additional/extra cost, reducing the processing time to 1 to 2 working days.

Application Procedure:

  • Consultation: You can reach out to Waytransit Travels & Tourism for consultation and choose the visa that suits your visit and requirements.
  • Document Submission: Provide all documents that are necessary for your visa category.
  • Payment of Fees: Set the fees and payments according to the visa type.
  • Application Submission: Waytransit Travels & Tourism will handle all of your document submissions ensuring that your information is correct.
  • Receive Visa: The visa will be emailed to you if approved. Print it out on your arrival in Abu Dhabi.
